content: If <Up>_[SoAd][Tp]CopyRxData() does not return BUFREQ_OK for a socket connection with PDU Header mode enabled, SoAd shall terminate the TP receive session, simply discard all data of the PDU and call <Up>_[SoAd][Tp]RxIndication() with E_NOT_OK.
